passages.provision_quote: Notwithstanding section 15-2401, beginning in the 2022-2023 school year, in this chapter, unless the context otherwise requires, "qualified student" includes a resident of this state who both: 1. Is eligible to enroll in a public school in this state in any of the following: ( a ) A preschool program for children with disabilities. ( b ) A kindergarten program. ( c ) Any of grades one through twelve. 2. Does not otherwise qualify for an Arizona empowerment scholarship account pursuant to this chapter.
passages.note: New section 15-2401.01 expands ESA eligibility to any public-school-eligible student statewide.
House Third Reading records Wilmeth voting Yea on final passage of HB2853.
Bill Status Inquiry lists Wilmeth as a co-sponsor of HB2853, which the Governor later signed.

rows.reasoning: Wilmeth co-sponsored HB2853 and voted Yea on final passage (WILMETH Y, 31-26-3-0-0); the enacted law adds section 15-2401.01 making any resident eligible to enroll in a public school (preschool, kindergarten, or grades one through twelve) a qualified student for an Arizona empowerment scholarship account, with no income cap. This matches the rung text "Providing universal vouchers so that education funding follows the student to any school — public, private, or religious — chosen by the family" rather than the capped-eligibility language of rung 4.
